89: def _native_exact(source, route):
90:     expected = NATIVE[route]
91:     observed = source["assertion_ids"]
92:     produced = source["expected_assertion_ids"]
93:     selected = source["selected_tests"]
94:     passed = source["passed_tests"]
95:     if (source.get("status") != "PASS" or source.get("task_id") != "W09"
96:             or source.get("check_id") != (route[2] or None)
97:             or source.get("case_id") != (route[3] or None)
98:             or source.get("scope") != SOURCE_SCOPE[route]
99:             or source.get("exit_code") != 0 or source.get("timed_out") is not False
100:             or not isinstance(observed, list) or not isinstance(produced, list)
101:             or len(observed) != len(set(observed))
102:             or sorted(observed) != sorted(expected)
103:             or sorted(produced) != sorted(expected)
104:             or source.get("assertions") != len(expected)
105:             or not isinstance(selected, list) or not selected
106:             or len(selected) != len(set(selected))
107:             or sorted(selected) != sorted(SELECTED[route])
108:             or sorted(passed) != sorted(selected)
109:             or not isinstance(source.get("actual_invocation"), list)
110:             or not isinstance(source.get("raw_evidence_references"), list)
111:             or len(source["raw_evidence_references"]) != 2
112:             or not source.get("report_reference")):
113:         raise ValueError("NATIVE_ROSTER_OR_SCOPE_MISMATCH")
114:     pins = [_pin(ref) for ref in [*source["raw_evidence_references"], source["report_reference"]]]
115:     report = json.loads(_inside_repo(source["report_reference"]).read_bytes())
116:     for key in ("status", "task_id", "check_id", "case_id", "scope", "exit_code", "run_id", "go_executable",
117:                 "timed_out", "assertions", "assertion_ids", "expected_assertion_ids",
118:                 "selected_tests", "passed_tests", "raw_evidence_references"):
119:         if report.get(key) != source.get(key):
120:             raise ValueError("SOURCE_REPORT_DISAGREES_WITH_RAW")
121:     records = report.get("assertion_results")
122:     if (not isinstance(records, list) or len(records) != len(expected)
123:             or sorted(record.get("assertion_id") for record in records) != sorted(expected)
124:             or any(record.get("status") != "PASS" or
125:                    record.get("raw_evidence_reference") != source["raw_evidence_references"][0]
126:                    for record in records)):
127:         raise ValueError("SOURCE_ASSERTION_RESULTS_INCOMPLETE")
128:     native = verify_native(ROOT, source, report, expected, selected)
129:     return pins, report, native

132: def _owned_exact(source, report, route):
133:     export = report.get("owned_export")
134:     if not isinstance(export, dict) or export.get("complete") is not True:
135:         raise ValueError("OWNED_EXPORT_NOT_COMPLETE")
136:     members = export.get("members")
137:     if not isinstance(members, list) or not members:
138:         raise ValueError("OWNED_EXPORT_MEMBERS_MISSING")
139:     report_path = _inside_repo(source["report_reference"])
140:     owned_root = (report_path.parent / "owned").resolve(strict=True)
141:     if not owned_root.is_dir() or owned_root.is_symlink():
142:         raise ValueError("OWNED_EXPORT_ROOT_BAD")
143:     member_map = {}
144:     for claimed in members:
145:         if not isinstance(claimed, dict):
146:             raise ValueError("OWNED_MEMBER_MALFORMED")
147:         path = _inside_repo(claimed["path"])
148:         if owned_root not in path.parents or path in member_map or path.is_symlink():
149:             raise ValueError("OWNED_MEMBER_FOREIGN_OR_DUPLICATE")
150:         actual = _pin(claimed["path"])
151:         if actual != claimed:
152:             raise ValueError("OWNED_MEMBER_PIN_DRIFT")
153:         member_map[path] = claimed
154:     actual_paths = {path.resolve(strict=True) for path in owned_root.rglob("*.raw")}
155:     if actual_paths != set(member_map):
156:         raise ValueError("OWNED_MEMBER_SET_MISMATCH")
157:     events = {}
158:     for path in member_map:
159:         label = path.name.split("-", 1)[-1].removesuffix(".raw")
160:         if label.startswith(("http-request", "http-response", "file-body-", "g02-junction-stdout")) or label in A06_MANIFEST_RAW_LABELS or __import__("re").fullmatch(r"simulated-opinion-(?:0[0-9]|1[0-9])", label):
161:             continue
162:         if label.startswith(("assertion-", "c19-", "chain-", "a06-", "g02-", "http-", "origins-", "state-", "file-")):
163:             try:
164:                 events.setdefault(label, []).append(json.loads(path.read_bytes()))
165:             except (UnicodeDecodeError, ValueError):
166:                 if not label.startswith(("http-request", "http-response", "file-body")):
167:                     raise ValueError("OWNED_EVENT_NOT_JSON")
168:     for exchange in events.get("http-exchange", []):
169:         if (exchange.get("delivery") != "IN_PROCESS_HTTptest_RECORDER"
170:                 or exchange.get("authorization_header_exported") is not False
171:                 or not isinstance(exchange.get("status"), int)
172:                 or not exchange.get("method") or not exchange.get("path")):
173:             raise ValueError("HTTP_EXCHANGE_MALFORMED")
174:         for field in ("request", "response"):
175:             claim = exchange.get(field)
176:             if not isinstance(claim, dict):
177:                 raise ValueError("HTTP_BODY_PIN_MISSING")
178:             path = Path(claim["path"]).resolve(strict=True)
179:             if path not in member_map or claim["sha256"] != member_map[path]["sha256"] or claim["bytes"] != member_map[path]["bytes"]:
180:                 raise ValueError("HTTP_BODY_PIN_DRIFT")
181:     for label, group in events.items():
182:         if label.startswith("file-"):
183:             for entry in group:
184:                 if not isinstance(entry, dict) or "exists" not in entry:
185:                     raise ValueError("FILE_OBSERVATION_MALFORMED")
186:                 if entry["exists"] is True and entry.get("type") == "regular":
187:                     claim = entry.get("body")
188:                     if not isinstance(claim, dict):
189:                         raise ValueError("FILE_BODY_PIN_MISSING")
190:                     path = Path(claim["path"]).resolve(strict=True)
191:                     if path not in member_map or claim["sha256"] != member_map[path]["sha256"] or claim["bytes"] != member_map[path]["bytes"]:
192:                         raise ValueError("FILE_BODY_PIN_DRIFT")
193:     records = report["assertion_results"]
194:     for record in records:
195:         name = "assertion-" + record["assertion_id"]
196:         if len(events.get(name, [])) != 1:
197:             raise ValueError("ASSERTION_RAW_CARDINALITY")
198:         raw = events[name][0]
199:         if (raw.get("assertion_id") != record["assertion_id"]
200:                 or raw.get("status") != "PASS"
201:                 or raw.get("actual") != record.get("evidence")
202:                 or not isinstance(raw.get("expected"), dict)
203:                 or not raw["expected"]):
204:             raise ValueError("ASSERTION_EXPECTED_ACTUAL_MISMATCH")
205:         if any(raw["actual"].get(key) != value for key, value in raw["expected"].items()):
206:             raise ValueError("ASSERTION_EXPECTED_VALUE_MISMATCH")
207:         claimed = record.get("owned_export_ref")
208:         if not isinstance(claimed, dict):
209:             raise ValueError("ASSERTION_RAW_REF_MISSING")
210:         path = Path(claimed["path"]).resolve(strict=True)
211:         if path not in member_map or claimed["sha256"] != member_map[path]["sha256"] or claimed["bytes"] != member_map[path]["bytes"]:
212:             raise ValueError("ASSERTION_RAW_REF_DRIFT")
213:         if path.parent.name != ASSERTION_OWNER[record["assertion_id"]]:
214:             raise ValueError("ASSERTION_RAW_TEST_OWNER_MISMATCH")
215:     if route[3] == "C19" or route[2] == "W09-G01":
216:         for label in ("c19-complete-graph-before", "c19-complete-graph-after", "chain-before-after", "origins-c19-before", "origins-c19-after"):
217:             if len(events.get(label, [])) != 1:
218:                 raise ValueError("C19_GRAPH_EXPORT_MISSING")
219:         before = events["c19-complete-graph-before"][0]
220:         after = events["c19-complete-graph-after"][0]
221:         if (len(before.get("records", [])) != 27 or len(after.get("records", [])) != 27
222:                 or before.get("counts", {}).get("independent_observed_count") != 2
223:                 or before.get("counts", {}).get("simulated_count") != 20
224:                 or before.get("counts", {}).get("unknown_count") != 1
225:                 or after.get("counts", {}).get("independent_observed_count") != 1
226:                 or after.get("counts", {}).get("unknown_count") != 6):
227:             raise ValueError("C19_GRAPH_COUNTS_MISMATCH")
228:         records = before["records"]
229:         if (len({row.get("evidence_id") for row in records}) != 27
230:                 or sum(row.get("evidence_kind") == "SIMULATED" for row in records) != 20
231:                 or sum(row.get("evidence_kind") == "OBSERVED" and row.get("origin_relation") == "UNKNOWN" for row in records) != 1
232:                 or len(events["origins-c19-before"][0].get("rows", [])) != 6):
233:             raise ValueError("C19_GRAPH_RELATIONS_MISMATCH")
234:         if len([label for label in events if label.startswith("file-c19-before-")]) != 7:
235:             raise ValueError("C19_INPUT_SNAPSHOTS_MISSING")
236:         if len([path for path in member_map if __import__("re").fullmatch(
237:                 r"[0-9]{8}-simulated-opinion-(?:0[0-9]|1[0-9])\.raw", path.name)]) != 20:
238:             raise ValueError("C19_SIMULATED_INPUTS_MISSING")
239:         rejection = events.get("c19-unsupported-relation-rejection", [])
240:         if len(rejection) != 1 or not rejection[0].get("actual_error"):
241:             raise ValueError("C19_UNSUPPORTED_RELATION_RESULT_MISSING")
242:     if route[3] == "A06" or route[2] in ("W09-G01", "W09-G02"):
243:         for label in ("a06-indexed-result", "a06-fallback-result", "state-a06-fts-indexed", "state-a06-fts-fallback"):
244:             if len(events.get(label, [])) != 1:
245:                 raise ValueError("A06_FTS_EXPORT_MISSING")
246:         if len(events.get("http-exchange", [])) < 1:
247:             raise ValueError("A06_HTTP_EXCHANGE_MISSING")
248:         for label in ("file-a06-initial-authorized", "file-a06-initial-denied", "file-a06-modified", "file-a06-moved-source-absent", "file-a06-moved-destination", "file-a06-deleted", "file-a06-revoked-body"):
249:             if len(events.get(label, [])) != 1:
250:                 raise ValueError("A06_FILE_TRANSITION_MISSING")
251:         escapes = events.get("a06-escape-rejection", [])
252:         if len(escapes) != 2 or any(not row.get("actual_error") or row.get("accepted") is not False for row in escapes):
253:             raise ValueError("A06_ESCAPE_RESULT_MISSING")
254:         initial = events["file-a06-initial-authorized"][0]
255:         initial_state = events.get("state-a06-before-capture", [])
256:         if (len(initial_state) != 1 or not initial.get("exists")
257:                 or Path(initial["path"]).parent != Path(initial_state[0].get("root_path", ""))
258:                 or initial_state[0].get("root_id") != initial.get("root_id")):
259:             raise ValueError("A06_ROOT_INPUT_NOT_BOUND")
260:         indexed = events["a06-indexed-result"][0]["result"]["hits"]
261:         fallback = events["a06-fallback-result"][0]["result"]["hits"]
262:         if (len(indexed) != 2 or len(fallback) != 2
263:                 or any(hit.get("backend") != "sqlite-fts5" for hit in indexed)
264:                 or any(hit.get("backend") != "bounded-scan" for hit in fallback)):
265:             raise ValueError("A06_FTS_OBSERVATION_MISMATCH")
266:     closed = verify_owned(ROOT, source, report, SELECTED[route], ASSERTION_OWNER)
267:     if route[3] == "C19" or route[2] == "W09-G01":
268:         verify_c19(closed)
269:     if route[3] == "A06" or route[2] in ("W09-G01", "W09-G02"):
270:         verify_a06(closed)
271:     return closed

280: def _pinned_native_report():
281:     relative = os.getenv("RESEARCHOS_W09_NATIVE_REPORT_REF", "")
282:     expected = os.getenv("RESEARCHOS_W09_NATIVE_REPORT_SHA256", "")
283:     if not relative or len(expected) != 64:
284:         raise ValueError("SEALED_NATIVE_REPORT_NOT_GIVEN")
285:     path = _inside_repo(relative)
286:     raw = path.read_bytes()
287:     if hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() != expected:
288:         raise ValueError("SEALED_NATIVE_REPORT_DRIFT")
289:     report = json.loads(raw)
290:     if report.get("formal_construction_acceptance") != "NOT_RUN_POSTRUN_REVIEW_PENDING":
291:         raise ValueError("NATIVE_PRODUCER_PRETENDS_FORMAL")
292:     tool_ref = os.getenv("RESEARCHOS_W09_TOOL_RUN_REF", "")
293:     tool_sha = os.getenv("RESEARCHOS_W09_TOOL_RUN_SHA256", "")
294:     tool_path = _inside_repo(tool_ref)
295:     tool_raw = tool_path.read_bytes()
296:     if hashlib.sha256(tool_raw).hexdigest() != tool_sha:
297:         raise ValueError("NATIVE_TOOL_RUN_PIN_DRIFT")
298:     tool = json.loads(tool_raw)
299:     if (tool.get("schema") != "researchos.w09-native-producer-tool-run.v1"
300:             or tool.get("report_ref") != relative or tool.get("report_sha256") != expected
301:             or tool.get("run_id") != report.get("run_id")
302:             or tool.get("actual_invocation") != report.get("actual_invocation")
303:             or tool.get("native_exit_code") != report.get("exit_code")
304:             or tool.get("stdout_ref") != report.get("raw_evidence_references", [None])[0]
305:             or tool.get("stderr_ref") != report.get("raw_evidence_references", [None, None])[1]
306:             or tool.get("stdout_sha256") != _pin(tool["stdout_ref"])["sha256"]
307:             or tool.get("stderr_sha256") != _pin(tool["stderr_ref"])["sha256"]):
308:         raise ValueError("NATIVE_TOOL_RUN_NOT_SAME_RUN")
309:     source = dict(report)
310:     source["report_reference"] = relative
311:     return source, report, tool
